# ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

This project was funded as a VISN 23 Strategic Planning Project for FY2005-2007.

It addresses the VISN's efforts to build a culture of continuous quality

improvement, evidence-based practice and optimal resource utilization.

This project has been guided by our project collaborators as well as the efforts

of the guideline review committee members. We would like to thank these

individuals for their time and thoughtful input.
